title: What If Earth Lost Gravity for 60 Seconds? 🌍 #Shorts
description:
What if Earth completely lost gravity for just 60 seconds? 🌍

At first, it's pure magic: your feet drift off the floor, coffee floats in mid-air, and kids do backflips over houses.

Until real physics launches you upward at 1,000 mph, the atmosphere blows out into space, and gravity snaps back on at the 60th second! 😱

Subscribe to @WhatIfDaily for weekly mind-bending animated science!
